verdict.rationale: Zoho CRM's built-in assistant Zia produces AI insights from the user's CRM data inside the product. It offers custom predictions such as deal win/loss likelihood and expected revenue, scores that identify prospects most likely to convert, and data retrieval on request. The evidence is marketing-level first-party copy only. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how insights and suggestions are surfaced (e.g., next-best-action recommendations or anomaly alerts), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Build custom predictions that align with your business requirements, such as the likelihood of winning or losing a deal, the expected revenue from it
Use Zia scores to identify the prospects who are most likely to convert into customers and prioritize them
Zia can create modules, reports, and workflows in seconds, as well as retrieve any data you ask for
